seo_title: AI B2B Catalog Translation: Sell Across Europe
seo_desc: Is your online store only selling locally due to language? We use AI to translate thousands of products with technical precision and local SEO.
author_pitch: As an AI Specialist, it frustrates me to see distributors and small manufacturers limiting their sales to the domestic market simply because translating a catalog of five thousand products into three languages costs a fortune with agencies. Using free plugins destroys your SEO and scares away international clients with robotic translations. I build AI systems, powered by efficient models like Gemini 2.5 Flash, that process your database and translate every item with technical precision, adapting the language to the local market so you can sell seamlessly across Europe.
title: The language barrier: AI to automate the SEO translation of your catalogs
body:
Are you losing sales opportunities in the rest of Europe because translating your entire technical product catalog is too expensive and slow?

For a B2B distributor or an industrial SME, expanding to markets like France or Germany is the natural step to grow. The problem comes when you face your database: thousands of SKUs with technical specifications, manuals, and descriptions that need to be translated. Hiring a traditional translation agency would cost tens of thousands of dollars and months of waiting. Faced with this wall, many companies give up and abandon internationalization, leaving the door open to foreign competitors who do speak their clients' language.

The trap of Automatic Translation Plugins

To try to save money, many e-commerce owners install free modules that translate the website on the fly. However, these literal tools do not understand the context of your industry, destroy the SEO structure, and translate technical jargon in a ridiculous way. Publishing a catalog with robotic translations and technical errors is the most direct way to destroy your brand's credibility in a new country.

Our solution: B2B Localization and Translation AI Engine

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we break down your business borders. We connect your e-commerce or ERP to advanced Artificial Intelligence models, designed to process massive data and generate translations with technical rigor and native SEO optimization.

  1. Massive Catalog Processing: The AI extracts your entire product database, respecting HTML tags, attributes, and variations so as not to break the architecture of your online store.
  2. Technical Jargon Translation (Contextual): We train the model with glossaries from your industrial sector so it understands exactly how parts, measurements, and regulations are named in the target country.
  3. International SEO Optimization: The system does not translate literally, but adapts the keywords to the search terms that your foreign buyers actually use on Google.
  4. Automatic Store Synchronization: Once validated, the thousands of texts are injected back into your platform (PrestaShop, WooCommerce, or custom-built) ready to be published with no manual work.

The Real Impact on your International Expansion

  • Immediate Opening of New Markets: You go from taking a year to translate your store to launching your e-commerce in three new European countries in a matter of weeks.
  • Brutal Reduction of Localization Costs: You save up to eighty percent of the budget a human translation agency would demand, while maintaining impeccable B2B quality.
  • Multiplication of Organic Traffic (SEO): By using natural language and native keywords, your products quickly start ranking on international search engines, capturing sales on autopilot.
